REG3_CONTACT.interpretation: three land properties alter modeled upper-zone N-water contact

REG3_OBSERVATION.equation: population_logC += gamma_soc*z_soc + gamma_clay*z_clay + gamma_slope*z_slope at the observation reach
REG3_OBSERVATION.interpretation: same covariates form a transferable spatial readout control; it is not a process claim

DYN_HYDRO_DELIVERY.interpretation: the previously supported frozen hydrologic-state score modulates land-to-water contact

SOURCE2.interpretation: one centered agricultural-versus-atmospheric source contrast; source uncertainty, not observed source provenance

MINERAL_LIFETIME.interpretation: finite labile-mineral persistence; not agricultural Legacy age

AQ_SIZE.interpretation: one hydrology-derived river-size scaling of aquatic removal

shared_covariate_rule: REG3_CONTACT and REG3_OBSERVATION use the identical SOC/clay/slope design so process embedding can be separated from readout compensation.

temporal_gate.improvement: at least one of station or tree CI95 upper < 0
temporal_gate.conditional: reported but not used to select process structure
temporal_gate.boundary: no extra parameter at its bound in >=2/3 folds
temporal_gate.regional_modifier: maximum absolute fitted REG3 modifier <=1.0 log unit

outputs: atomic per-candidate checkpoints plus combined predictions, parameters, structural audits, metrics and decision
successor_rule: Only temporally eligible candidates enter Stage47 nested spatial validation.
